==Description==
The '''Witch''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Nightmare Carnival]] as part of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]. The '''Witch''' was quite fast and could not collide with the [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] and [[Railgun Tank]], though it could collide with other [[units]] like the [[Humvee 3]] or [[Mafia]]. The '''Witch''' had low health for its debut, and thus could be easily defeated.

==Appearance==
The '''Witch''' had green skin and glowing green eyes. Its torso and legs were black, and it had a mischievous face. It rode on a broom, levitating above the ground. It also wore a sorcerer's hat.

==Strategy==
*The [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] and [[Railgun Tank]] cannot collide with the '''Witch'''.
**They can still shoot the '''Witch''', meaning that they are not totally useless against the '''Witch'''.
**All other [[Military Base]] [[units]], [[Shotgunner|Enforcer]]'s [[SWAT Van]] and [[Crook Boss]] minions can collide with the '''Witch'''.
*The '''Witch's''' fast speed means that you should use towers that can slow them down, such as the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Freezer]].
*As they are weak, high DPS towers, like the [[Ranger|Outlaw]] and [[Minigunner]], should be used to deal with them.
**In addition, the [[Rocketeer]] can be quite useful against the '''Witch''' as they spawn in large numbers.

==Trivia==
*This was the first [[Enemies|enemy]] that had [[Collision Immunity]], tied with the [[Bat (Nightmare Carnival)|Bat]], though the [[Bat (Nightmare Carnival)|Bat]] cannot collide with all [[units]], while the '''Witch''' cannot collide with [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] and [[Railgun Tank]] only.
**This is the second enemy to fly, after the [[UFO (Area 51)|UFO]] and tied with the [[Bat (Nightmare Carnival)|Bat]].
*The hat used by the '''Witch''' is the a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|1165243|Witch Hat}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
**The broom used by the '''Witch''' is the {{RLinkC|36913601|Broom}} gear from the Roblox catalog.
*The face the '''Witch''' uses, which is an edited version to have green eyes, is the {{RLinkC|8329686|Sinister}} face from the Roblox catalog.
